description: A shift register of random bits that loops as a sequence, giving a stepped voltage and a trigger, in 2HP

params.text: Sets what happens to the bit entering the register on each clock: centred makes it random, fully clockwise locks the loop, and moving left of centre doubles the loop length with the same chances
Sets how many steps the loop runs, up to 16, and up to 32 with the CTR knob left of centre

inputs.text: Moves the CTR setting, added to the CTR knob
Advances the register one step on each trigger
A trigger here restarts the sequence from its beginning
A trigger here clears the register, turning every bit off

outputs.text: The voltage built from the on bits of the register, attenuated by the SCL knob
A 1ms pulse each time the sequence advances onto an on bit, or a gate or a clock-width pulse under Trig Output type

notes: every bit off gives 0V and every bit on gives 10V; each bit position is worth a different amount, doubling as you go by default.
menu: Bit Resolution: 8 bit, 16 bit — sets how many of the register's bits the output voltage is built from
Voltage progression: 2x (std.), 1.3x, Fibonacci — sets how much each further bit is worth in the output voltage
Trig Output type: Trig, Gate, Clock Width — chooses whether an on bit sends a 1ms pulse, a gate held until an off bit, or a pulse the length of the incoming clock's high part
Don't advance — makes the first clock after a reset hold on the first step rather than moving off it
DISK operations — a submenu with Import trigSeq seq. and Export trigSeq seq., which read and write the working sequence as a file the trigSeq modules can also use
Initialize on Start — clears the register when Rack loads a patch

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
